document.title: text-generation-webui: Jinja2 sandbox breakout via model-supplied chat templates

notes.title: Not an official advisory
notes.text: This is an independent portfolio exercise demonstrating CSAF authoring. It is not published by or affiliated with the text-generation-webui project or Pallets.

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: text-generation-webui v1.8 depends on jinja2 3.1.2, which is affected by CVE-2025-27516. The application renders chat templates loaded from model metadata inside Jinja's sandbox, so a malicious model can supply a template that escapes the sandbox and executes arbitrary Python code on the user's machine.

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

vulnerabilities.title: Jinja2 sandbox breakout through the attr filter

notes.text: An oversight in how the Jinja sandboxed environment interacts with the |attr filter allows an attacker who controls template content to obtain a reference to a string's unsandboxed format method and execute arbitrary Python code. Fixed in jinja2 3.1.6.

notes.title: Product-specific impact
notes.text: modules/models_settings.py reads tokenizer.chat_template from model metadata, and modules/chat.py renders it with ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment.from_string. Template content is therefore controlled by whoever published the model.

threats.details: No known exploitation in the wild of this product at time of writing.

remediations.details: Upgrade jinja2 to 3.1.6 or later (pin jinja2>=3.1.6 in requirements).
Load models only from trusted publishers, and review the chat template shown in the UI before generating text with a new model.
